purpose: Synthetic regression fleet. No operator observations or deployment evidence.

telemetry.local_observed_usage: OpenCode step_finish events and read-only opencode.db reconciliation
telemetry.local_cost_semantics: estimated equivalent cost from local model pricing; never authoritative Go quota debit

states.HEALTHY: fresh direct bottleneck usage from 50% through 74%
states.CONSERVE: fresh direct bottleneck usage from 75% through 89%
states.CRITICAL: fresh direct bottleneck usage at least 90%
states.EXHAUSTED: explicit quota error or trusted 100% snapshot
states.UNKNOWN: no direct console snapshot or snapshot older than one hour

antigravity-gemini.label: Antigravity · Gemini
antigravity-gemini.exhaustion_behaviour: HARD FAIL, not degradation: when the cap is hit Antigravity returns RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (429) with a reset timer, and does not fall back to a lighter model. So EXHAUSTED keeps blocking this pool; treating 100% as 'degraded but usable' would send calls straight into a 429.

gemini-metered.label: Gemini API
gemini-metered.enforcement: wrapper admission (fleetctl acquire) refuses the next call once the calendar day's recorded estimated spend reaches the cap; a single in-flight run can overshoot by at most its own cost because max_parallel is 1
gemini-metered.recommended_backstop: set a hard requests-per-day quota or a low budget on the Google API key as a true stop

openrouter-free.label: OpenRouter
openrouter-free.billing: OpenRouter's free tier: zero marginal cost per call, checked live against OpenRouter's own pricing before every request.
openrouter-free.quota_source: none: OpenRouter publishes no percentage for the free tier; the per-call pricing check is the rail.

example-model-key.note: Free-text evidence about how this model actually performed for you. Priors, never verdicts: replace with your own observations.

model_cards._about: Optional plain-language cards for the console's model switches. name, best_for (one line), speed (only when measured), run_as (the id a direct wrapper passes; default the key), aliases, pool (for models with no routing lane), status current|older, order, allowance, hidden. A card never admits a routing lane.
